title: Open-coding cases
description: One object per trace to code. The coder renders a card per row. Extra keys beyond those listed survive the round-trip into dataset item metadata, so attach anything you'll want to filter on later (family, severity, model, etc.).

trace_id.description: Stable id; drives the dataset item id (uuid5) and the /load round-trip.

prompt.description: The task given to the agent. Shown as the card title.

final_answer.description: The agent's last message. Shown in the expandable answer panel and used as the dataset expected_output.

goal_met.description: Outcome signal surfaced on the card so you code against observable result, not prose.

trajectory.description: Event list; the coder collapses it to per-event counts (step.planned, step.executed, error.occurred, ...).

rationale.description: Judge's reasoning, shown for context. NOT a substitute for reading the trajectory.

want_depth.description: GoalJudge-specific: intended planning depth (L0/L1/L2). Renders a want->fired badge when paired with fired_depth.

fired_depth.description: GoalJudge-specific: depth the pipeline actually emitted.

examples.prompt: Design a rate limiter for the API.
examples.final_answer: Designing a rate limiter involves... (token bucket, Redis sliding window) ...
examples.rationale: The answer thoroughly addresses the task.
